item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.0 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.0 Preview
Removal Queue is now **Clean Sweep**. Existing queues, preferences, recovery snapshots, and update notices carry forward.
- Choose **Remove**, **Heal**, or **Clone** as your marking brush in Settings. Remove remains the default. The choice applies when marking starts; browsing leaves your current Develop tool alone. - **Clear Queue** is now on the main window. It asks before clearing and keeps your photo edits and recovery snapshots. - A shorter floating window combines mode, readiness, and the processing estimate in one status line. Settings is a gear button; full details remain in Settings and tooltips. - Lightroom keeps the same five menu commands, now under Clean Sweep. Unchanged shortcuts installed by earlier versions migrate to the new names; custom assignments are preserved. - The existing marked/processed collections are reused. Only their old default names change; custom names are kept.
Download `CleanSweep-0.6.0-preview.zip` and replace the complete `RemovalQueue.lrplugin` folder. Its folder name and internal identifiers remain unchanged to keep Lightroom registrations and saved batches working. Restart Lightroom to refresh menus and scripts. If shortcuts were migrated on that launch, restart again when convenient for macOS to reload them.
Automated behavior and compatibility checks pass, including all three marking preferences, clear/cancel handling, status updates, and shortcut migration. Native interaction with the new controls still needs broader testing. Smart Preview-only and Windows workflows retain their preview validation status.
